working_title: Beyond the Periodic Table: Predictive Geometry of Cross-Linguistic Structural Space
historical_hypothesis_title: Testing the Periodic-Table Hypothesis of Human Language
subtitle: A Predictive Comparison of Periodic and Non-Periodic Models of Cross-Linguistic Structure
promotion_target: next available paper ID after robustness and ARIS review gates
core_question: What geometry best predicts cross-linguistic structural relations out of sample, and does any global or pre-defined local periodic representation add reproducible value beyond non-periodic alternatives?

stage0.claim_limit: Prerequisite structural signal only; no periodicity claim.

current_interpretation: Evidence favors structured but non-periodic predictive geometry over a simple global or predefined local periodic system. Standard circular-seriation, geography, capacity, replication, and formal reviewer checks remain before manuscript-level claims.
